newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: FIATA/AFI outline Caracas congress details.
newsitem.headline: FIATA/AFI outline Caracas congress details.

text.p: FIATA (International Federation of Freight Forwarders Associations), said a meeting of the affiliated the Airfreight Institute (AFI), forms part of the programme for its annual congress, to be held in Caracas, la between September 29 and October 3.
The congress will includes a forum on the theme, "The freight forwarder - the best choice in global logistics" and a presentation on freight forwarding in Venezuela and Latin America, FIATA said.

The main topic of discussion at the AFI meeting will be bar-code technology, with a presentation by Daniel Desmaisons, director of Industry Affairs, Air France Cargo and Chuck Evanoe, president of Century Systems Inc.,said AFI manager, Sandro Consoli.

Other topics on the AFI meeting's agenda include the Business Anti-Smuggling Coalition (BASC), with a presentation by Allan Gina, headquarters programme manager for initiatives in the private sector, U.S. Customs, Consoli added.
The AFI meeting will also discuss security measures and
receive an update on Cargo Account Settlement System (CASS)
development in the Philippines and Korea.
